encounters.title: The New Kid
encounters.intro: Leo doesn't know anyone here yet. Help him feel welcome. Each idea works once - the order matters!
encounters.need: Leo moved here last week. He misses his old friends and feels like he doesn't belong anywhere yet.

actions.label: Listen
actions.text: You sit down and ask how he's doing. Leo says he moved here last week and misses his old friends.

actions.label: Tell a joke
actions.text: You tell your best banana joke. Leo almost smiles.

actions.label: Ask Maya to say hi
actions.text: Maya bounces over: "Hi! I'm Maya! Do you like lemonade?" Leo can't help grinning.

actions.label: Invite him to the pushcart
actions.text: "We could really use someone creative at our pushcart. Want to join us?" Leo's eyes light up.
actions.text_unrevealed: Leo shrugs. "Why would you want me? You don't even know me."

actions.label: Leave him alone
actions.text: You decide to give Leo some space.

encounters.title: Talking Business
encounters.intro: Mr. Okafor rents out the market stalls. 60 coins is a lot. Can you convince him to give you a better price?
encounters.need: Too many young stall holders get bored after a week and leave their stall empty. Mr. Okafor wants someone he can count on.

actions.label: Ask what worries him
actions.text: You ask what he looks for in a stall holder. "Too many youngsters rent a stall, get bored after a week and leave it empty," he sighs.

actions.label: Show your sales notebook
actions.text: You show him every sale you've written down. He nods slowly. "You know your numbers."

actions.label: Promise to open every day
actions.text: "Every day, rain or shine," you promise. That's exactly what he wanted to hear.

actions.label: Mention Grandpa's old pushcart
actions.text: "Your grandfather? He sold the best toffee apples in town!" Mr. Okafor smiles for the first time.

actions.label: Beg for a discount
actions.text: "Please, please, PLEASE?" Mr. Okafor frowns. "Business is business."

actions.label: Accept the full price
actions.text: You decide 60 coins is a fair price.

encounters.title: The Grumpy Customer
encounters.intro: Mrs. Grumble is furious about warm lemonade. Can you turn an angry customer around?
encounters.need: Her bus was late, her feet hurt, and the warm lemonade was the last straw. She needs to feel heard - and to sit down.

actions.label: Listen without interrupting
actions.text: You let her talk. Her bus was late, her feet hurt, and the warm lemonade was the last straw.

actions.label: Say sorry
actions.text: "I'm really sorry about the lemonade." Her shoulders drop a little.

actions.label: Explain it's not your fault
actions.text: "It's the sun's fault, not mine!" Mrs. Grumble turns red. "EXCUSES!"

actions.label: Give her a cold drink for free
actions.text: You hand her an ice-cold cup. "On the house." She sniffs, but takes it.

actions.label: Offer her a seat in the shade
actions.text: You bring a stool into the shade. "Rest your feet." Mrs. Grumble actually smiles.
actions.text_unrevealed: "Why would I want to sit down?" she snaps.

actions.label: Ask Maya to fetch ice
actions.text: Maya runs to Kofi's stall and comes back with ice. "For your drink!"

actions.label: Walk away
actions.text: You walk away. Behind you, Mrs. Grumble is still talking.

encounters.title: Market Rivals
encounters.intro: Kofi is upset that your stall sells apples next to his fruit stall. Fight or work together?
encounters.need: Kofi's uncle is sick, so Kofi runs the fruit stall alone. If he sells less fruit, his whole family has less money.

actions.label: Ask how his stall is doing
actions.text: Kofi sighs. His uncle is sick, so he runs the stall alone. If he sells less fruit, his family has less money too.

actions.label: "It's a free market!"
actions.text: Kofi folds his arms. "Easy for you to say."

actions.label: Offer a deal: no apples from you, drinks from him
actions.text: "You don't sell drinks, I don't sell fruit. You send me thirsty people, I send you hungry ones." Kofi's face lights up.
actions.text_unrevealed: "Why would I make a deal with you? You're taking my customers!"

actions.label: Ask Leo to paint a sign for both stalls
actions.text: Leo sketches a sign: <- FRUIT  |  DRINKS ->. Kofi laughs. "Okay, that's actually clever."

actions.label: Offer him a free lemonade
actions.text: Kofi takes a sip. "Okay... that's good lemonade."

actions.label: Ignore him
actions.text: You turn back to your stall. Kofi glares at you all afternoon.

encounters.title: Asking for a Loan
encounters.intro: You want to borrow 80 coins for a fridge. Ms. Adeyemi decides the interest rate. Convince her you're a safe borrower.
encounters.need: A loan is a promise. Ms. Adeyemi needs a clear plan for how you'll pay it back on time, every single week.

actions.label: Explain what the fridge is for
actions.text: "Cold drinks sell better and last longer. The fridge will pay for itself!" She writes something down.

actions.label: Ask what she needs to know
actions.text: She smiles. "A loan is a promise. I need to know HOW you'll pay it back."

actions.label: Show your sales notebook
actions.text: You show her sales from the pushcart, the stall and the shop. She nods slowly.

actions.label: Show your weekly repayment plan
actions.text: You show her: 22 coins a week from shop profits, for 4 weeks. "Now THAT is a plan."
actions.text_unrevealed: "A plan for what, exactly?" she asks.

actions.label: Promise you'll be rich one day
actions.text: "Promises don't pay loans," she says gently.

actions.label: Maybe we should save up instead
actions.text: You decide to think about it some more.
